description:
List the companies this connection may act for, and what it may
do on each.

Call it before acting when the user has more than one company, or
when a tool answered that it needs a company. Each row carries the
company_id (UUID) and tax_id (CNPJ or CPF) the other tools accept as
company_id or company_tax_id, and the permissions granted there.

One connection may cover several companies; when it covers only
one, the other tools need no company at all. Read-only.
name: list_authorized_companies

AuthorizedCompany.description: One company this connection may act for, and what it may do there.

company_id.description: The company's UUID. Pass it as company_id to act for this company.

permissions.description: The scopes granted on this company: invoice:read consults and lists, invoice:issue issues and reissues, invoice:write corrects and manifests, invoice:cancel cancels and invalidates numbering.

tax_id.description: The company's CNPJ or CPF. Pass it as company_tax_id to act for this company.

outputSchema.description: Every company the connection covers, in one environment.

environment.description: homologation or production, for every company here.
